choice_context: Which movie would you rather watch right now?

choice_only.label: Choice Only
choice_only.description: Binary choice, no dimension information shown.

choice_readonly_sliders.label: Choice + Read-Only Sliders
choice_readonly_sliders.description: Binary choice with top-5 dimension scores shown (not adjustable).

choice_adjustable_sliders.label: Choice + Adjustable Sliders
choice_adjustable_sliders.description: Binary choice with top-5 adjustable dimension sliders that co-move.

choice_checkboxes.label: Choice + Relevance Checkboxes
choice_checkboxes.description: Binary choice with top-5 dimensions shown as checkboxes.

inference_affirm.label: Inferences: Affirm / Remove
inference_affirm.description: Affirm or remove model inferences about your preferences.

inference_categories.label: Inferences: Category Selection
inference_categories.description: Adjust the category for each inference about your preferences.

dimensions.name: Action Intensity

dimensions.name: Humor Intensity

dimensions.name: Historical Authenticity

dimensions.name: Suspense/Atmosphere
dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on sustained tension and atmospheric quality

dimensions.name: Sci-Fi/Fantasy Worldbuilding
dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on depth of speculative world construction

dimensions.name: Survival/Stress Scenarios
dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on prominence of survival challenges

dimensions.name: Visual Spectacle
dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on visual creativity and technical execution

dimensions.name: Adventure Scope

dimensions.name: Family-Friendly Content
dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on explicit family-friendly design

instructions.training:
Practice

Before the main task, you’ll do a few short practice trials to learn the preference dimensions used in this study.

Each practice trial shows one dimension and asks which option is more aligned with it. After you click, we’ll tell you whether you were right.
instructions.feedback:
Main Task

You will be shown pairs of options. For each pair, click the one you prefer.
